cues.en: If you've done any previous research in deep learning you've probably heard of the tensorflow library.
cues.zh: 如果以前研究過深度學習，應該聽過 TensorFlow 函式庫。

cues.en: It's a very popular framework developed by the folks at Google and they've been kind enough to make it open source and freely available to the world.
cues.zh: 它是 Google 團隊開發的熱門框架，而且他們很慷慨，將它開源，讓全世界免費使用。

cues.en: So let's talk about what tensorflow is all about and how it can help you construct artificial neural networks.
cues.zh: 談談 TensorFlow 是什麼，以及如何協助建立人工神經網路。

cues.en: The thing that kind of took me by surprise when I first encountered tensorflow, was that it wasn't really purpose built for deep learning at first, or even for neural networks in general.
cues.zh: 第一次接觸 TensorFlow 時，讓我有點驚訝的是，它最初其實不是專門為深度學習，甚至不是專門為一般神經網路設計的。

cues.en: It's a much more general-purpose tool that Google developed.
cues.zh: 它是 Google 開發、用途廣泛得多的工具。

cues.en: That just happens to be useful for developing deep learning and neural networks. More generally it's an architecture for executing a graph of numerical operations.
cues.zh: 只是剛好能用來開發深度學習與神經網路。更一般地說，它是執行數值運算圖的架構。

cues.en: It's not just about neural networks. You can have any sequence of operations and define a graph of how
cues.zh: 不只神經網路，任何一連串運算，都能定義成圖，描述

cues.en: those operations fit together. What tensorflow actually does is figure out how to distribute that processing
cues.zh: 運算如何組合。TensorFlow 實際做的，是找出如何將這些處理分散到

cues.en: across the various GPU cause on your P.C. or across various machines on a network and make sure that you can do massive computing problems in a distributed manner.
cues.zh: 電腦上不同 GPU 核心，或網路上不同機器，確保能以分散方式，處理大規模運算問題。

cues.en: In that respect it sounds a lot like Apache Spark.
cues.zh: 從這方面來說，很像 Apache Spark。

cues.en: If you've taken other courses from me you've probably heard me talk about spark, it's a very exciting technology and spark is also developing machine learning and A.I. and deep learning capabilities of its own.
cues.zh: 如果上過我的其他課，可能聽我談過 Spark。它是很棒的技術，也正在發展自己的機器學習、AI 與深度學習能力。

cues.en: So in some ways tensorflow is a competitor to Apache Spark but there are some key differences that we should talk about.
cues.zh: 因此，某些方面，TensorFlow 是 Apache Spark 的競爭者，但有一些重要差異要談。

cues.en: It's not just about distributing graphs of computation across a cluster or across your GPU. You can also run tensorflow on just about anything.
cues.zh: 它不只把運算圖分散到叢集或 GPU，也能在幾乎任何裝置上執行。

cues.en: So one thing that's special about tensorflow, is that I can even run it on my phone if I want to.
cues.zh: TensorFlow 特別的一點，是想要的話，甚至能在手機上執行。

cues.en: It's not limited to running on computers in a cluster in some data center.
cues.zh: 不侷限於資料中心叢集裡的電腦。

cues.en: That's important because in the real world you might want to push that processing down to the end users device.
cues.zh: 這很重要，因為真實世界中，可能想把處理工作下放到終端使用者裝置。

cues.en: Let's take the example of a self-driving car.
cues.zh: 以自駕車為例。

cues.en: You wouldn't want your car to suddenly crash into a wall just because it lost its network connection to the cloud.
cues.zh: 你不會希望汽車只因為失去雲端網路連線，就突然撞牆。

cues.en: Now would you.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: The way that it actually works is that you might push the actual trained neural network down to the car itself and actually execute that neural network on the computer that's running embedded within your
cues.zh: 實際做法可能是，把訓練好的神經網路下放到車子，在車內的嵌入式電腦上執行

cues.en: car, because the heavy lifting of deep learning is training that network. So you can do that training off line push the weights of that network down to your car, which is relatively small and then run that
cues.zh: 神經網路。因為深度學習最繁重的工作是訓練，所以可以離線訓練，再把相對較小的網路權重送到車上，讓

cues.en: neural network completely within your car itself. By being able to run tensor flow in a variety of devices.
cues.zh: 整個神經網路完全在車內執行。TensorFlow 能在各種裝置上執行，

cues.en: It opens up a lot of possibilities about actually doing deep learning on the edge on the actual devices where you're trying to use it on. Tensorflow is written in C++ under the hood whereas spark is written
cues.zh: 就為邊緣深度學習，也就是在實際使用的裝置上執行，開啟很多可能性。TensorFlow 內部用 C++ 撰寫，Spark 則用

cues.en: in Scala, which ultimately runs on top of a JVM. By going down to the C++ level with tensorflow that's going to give you greater efficiency, but at the same time it has a python interface so you can talk
cues.zh: Scala，最後在 JVM 上執行。TensorFlow 使用 C++ 層級，效率更高，但同時有 Python 介面，所以能像

cues.en: to it just like you would any other python library. That makes it easy to program and easy to use as a developer but very efficient and very fast under the hood.
cues.zh: 任何 Python 函式庫一樣操作。對開發者容易寫、容易用，內部卻高效又快速。

cues.en: The other key difference between tensorflow and something like spark is that it can work on GPU's.
cues.zh: TensorFlow 與 Spark 等工具的另一個重要差異，是能使用 GPU。

cues.en: A GPU is just your video card, the same video card that you're using to play Fortnight on or whatever it is you play.
cues.zh: GPU 就是顯示卡，也就是玩 Fortnite 或其他遊戲的同一張顯示卡。

cues.en: You can actually distribute the work across the GPU course on your P.C. and it's a very common configuration to even have multiple video cards on a single computer and actually use that to gain more performance
cues.zh: 可以把工作分散到電腦的 GPU 核心，而專為深度學習打造的叢集，也很常在單一電腦中裝多張顯示卡，

cues.en: on clusters that are purpose built, for deep learning. Plus tensorflow is free and it's made by Google just the fact that it's made by Google has led to a lot of adoption.
cues.zh: 提高效能。而且 TensorFlow 免費，又是 Google 製作，光是 Google 這點，就促成很多採用。

cues.en: There are competing libraries out there to tensorflow notably Apache MXnet but tensorflow as of right now is still by far the most popular.
cues.zh: 也有競爭函式庫，尤其 Apache MXNet，但截至目前，TensorFlow 仍遠遠最受歡迎。

cues.en: Installing tensorflow is really easy.
cues.zh: 安裝 TensorFlow 很簡單。

cues.en: All you have to do is use the conda command in your Anaconda environment to install tensorflow or you can use Anaconda Navigator to do it all through a graphical user interface.
cues.zh: 只要在 Anaconda 環境用 conda 命令安裝，或透過 Anaconda Navigator，以圖形介面完成。

cues.en: There's also a tensorflow dash GPU package you can install instead.
cues.zh: 也可以改裝 tensorflow-gpu 套件，

cues.en: If you want to take advantage of GPU acceleration.
cues.zh: 如果要利用 GPU 加速。

cues.en: If you're running this on Windows I wouldn't go there quite yet.
cues.zh: 如果使用 Windows，我還不建議這麼做。

cues.en: I've had some trouble getting tensorflow GPU to work on my own windows system.
cues.zh: 我自己在 Windows 系統上讓 TensorFlow GPU 運作，就遇過一些困難。

cues.en: You'll find that a lot of these technologies are developed primarily for Linux systems running on a cluster.
cues.zh: 你會發現，這些技術很多主要為叢集上的 Linux 系統開發。

cues.en: So if you're running on a purpose built computer in a cluster on EC2 or something that's made for deep learning.
cues.zh: 所以，如果你用的是 EC2 叢集等專為深度學習打造的電腦，

cues.en: Go ahead and install tensorflow dash GPU, although it's probably going to be installed for you already.
cues.zh: 就安裝 tensorflow-gpu，雖然很可能已經替你裝好了。

cues.en: Let's talk about what tensorflow is all about.
cues.zh: 談談 TensorFlow 究竟是什麼。

cues.en: What is a tensor anyway.
cues.zh: Tensor 到底是什麼？

cues.en: Well this is another example of fancy pretentious terminology that people use to make themselves look smart at the end of the day.
cues.zh: 這又是一個華麗、裝腔作勢的術語，人們用來讓自己看起來很聰明。

cues.en: A tensor is just a fancy name for an array or a matrix of values.
cues.zh: 張量，只是陣列或數值矩陣的華麗名稱。

cues.en: It's just a structured collection of numbers.
cues.zh: 就是有結構的一組數字。

cues.en: That's it.
cues.zh: 就這樣。

cues.en: That's all a tensor is using tensorflow can be a little bit counterintuitive but it's similar to how something like Apache Spark would work too.
cues.zh: 張量就是這樣。TensorFlow 使用方式可能有點不直覺，但也類似 Apache Spark。

cues.en: You don't actually execute things right away.
cues.zh: 不是立刻執行。

cues.en: Instead you build up a graph of how you want things to execute and then when you're ready to execute it you say; "okay tensorflow go do this". TensorFlow will then go and figure out the optimal way to distribute
cues.zh: 而是先建立想如何執行的圖，準備好時再說：「好，TensorFlow，執行。」TensorFlow 會找出最佳方式，分散

cues.en: in parallel lives that work across your entire set of GPUs and computers in your cluster. So let's take a look here at the world's simplest tensorflow application in python.
cues.zh: 並平行化工作，利用所有 GPU 與叢集電腦。看看世上最簡單的 Python TensorFlow 應用程式。

cues.en: All this is going to do is add one plus two together but it's a good illustrated example of what's actually going on under the hood.
cues.zh: 它只會把一加二，但能很好地說明內部發生什麼事。

cues.en: We start by importing the tensorflow library.
cues.zh: 先匯入 TensorFlow 函式庫。

cues.en: We're going to refer to it as T.F as a shorthand.
cues.zh: 簡寫為 tf。

cues.en: We'll start off by saying A=TF.variable1, Name=A and all that is doing is setting up a variable in tensorflow a variable object which
cues.zh: 先寫 a = tf.Variable(1, name='a')，這只是在 TensorFlow 建立變數物件，

cues.en: contains a single value one and which is going by the name of a.
cues.zh: 包含單一數值一，名稱是 a。

cues.en: The name is what will appear in visualisation tools for your graphic if you're using that sort of a thing. But internally will also assign that to a variable in Python called a. Then we set up a B variable
cues.zh: 這個名稱會出現在計算圖的視覺化工具中，如果你有使用；內部也指定給 Python 變數 a。接著建立變數 b，

cues.en: that's assigned to the value two and given the name B.
cues.zh: 指定為二，名稱是 b。

cues.en: Here's where the magic starts to happen.
cues.zh: 神奇之處開始了。

cues.en: We say F=A+B and you might think that would put the number three into the variable F but it doesn't F is actually your graph.
cues.zh: 寫 f = a + b，你可能以為三會放進 f，但沒有，f 其實是計算圖。

cues.en: It's the connection that you're building up between the A and B tensors to add them together.
cues.zh: 也就是建立 a 與 b 張量間的連線，將它們相加。

cues.en: So F=A+B does not do anything except establish that relationship between A and B and their dependency together on that f graph that you're creating. Nothing actually happens until we try to access
cues.zh: 因此，f = a + b 只建立 a、b 的關係，以及它們對 f 圖的相依性，除此之外不做任何事。直到試著存取

cues.en: the value of f, at which point tensorflow two uses something called eager execution to actually execute that graph at that point. It will say "OK I need to create a graph that takes to a variable which contains
cues.zh: f 的值時，才會發生事情；這時 TensorFlow 2 使用所謂的立即執行，在那一刻執行圖。它會說：「好，要建立一個圖，把包含

cues.en: one and the B variable which contains two and add them together". It will figure out how to distribute that incredibly complicated operation.
cues.zh: 一的變數 a，與包含二的變數 b 相加。」它會想辦法把這個「極為複雜」的運算分散，

cues.en: I'm being sarcastic, across your entire cluster and that will ultimately print the value 3 in the form of a new tensor. So we have just created the most complicated way imaginable of computing one plus two.
cues.zh: 我是在開玩笑，分散到整個叢集，最後以新張量形式，印出三。因此，我們剛建立了能想像最複雜的一加二計算方式。

cues.en: But if these were larger tensors dealing with larger data sets or for example a huge array or a matrix of weights and a neural network, that distribution of the work becomes important.
cues.zh: 但如果是處理大型資料集的更大張量，例如龐大陣列，或神經網路的權重矩陣，分散工作就很重要。

cues.en: So although adding one plus two isn't a useful exercise to do with the tensorflow.
cues.zh: 因此，雖然用 TensorFlow 算一加二沒什麼實用價值，

cues.en: Once you scale this up to the many many connections in a big neural network it becomes very important to be able to distribute these things effectively.
cues.zh: 但擴展到大型神經網路的眾多連線時，能有效分散工作就很重要。

cues.en: So how do we extend this idea to neural networks.
cues.zh: 如何把這個想法延伸到神經網路？

cues.en: Well the thing with tensorflow is that it's not only just made for neural networks. It can do things like matrix multiplication.
cues.zh: TensorFlow 不只為神經網路設計，也能做矩陣乘法等運算。

cues.en: And it turns out that you can think about applying all the different weights and sums that happen within a single layer of a perceptron and model that is just matrix multiplication.
cues.zh: 而感知器某一層中，各種權重套用與加總，其實都能建模成矩陣乘法。

cues.en: You can just take the output of the previous layer and you're multi-layer perceptron and do a matrix multiplication with a matrix that describes the weights between each neuron of the two layers that you're computing.
cues.zh: 可以取得多層感知器前一層輸出，與描述兩層各神經元之間權重的矩陣，相乘。

cues.en: Then you can add in a vector that contains the biased terms as well. So at the end of the day you can modify this fancy diagram here of what a perceptron looks like.
cues.zh: 接著，加上包含偏差項的向量。因此，最後可以把這張感知器的華麗圖，

cues.en: And just model it as a matrix multiplication in vector addition.
cues.zh: 簡化成矩陣乘法與向量加法。

cues.en: Go back and read up on your linear algebra if you want to know more about how that works mathematically.
cues.zh: 想知道更多數學運作，可以回頭讀線性代數。

cues.en: But this is just a straightforward matrix multiplication operation with a vector addition at the end for the bias terms. By using tensorflows lower level API.
cues.zh: 但它就是直接的矩陣乘法，最後再加偏差項向量。使用 TensorFlow 較低階 API，

cues.en: We're kind of doing this the hard way. But there are higher-level APIs and tensorflow that make it much simpler and more intuitive to define deep neural networks. As we're describing tensor flow at a low level
cues.zh: 有點是在走困難的路。不過 TensorFlow 有更高階 API，能更簡單、直覺地定義深度神經網路。目前是在低階層次，

cues.en: right now.
cues.zh: 描述 TensorFlow。

cues.en: Its purpose in life is just to distribute mathematical operations on groups of numbers or tensors and it's up to us to describe what we're trying to do in mathematical terms.
cues.zh: 它的任務，就是分散對一組數字或張量的數學運算，而我們負責用數學方式描述要做的事情。

cues.en: It turns out it's really not that hard to do with a neural network.
cues.zh: 對神經網路而言，其實沒那麼難。

cues.en: For us to actually compute a complete deep learning network from end to end.
cues.zh: 要真正從頭到尾計算完整深度學習網路，

cues.en: There's more to it than just computing the weights between different layers of neurons.
cues.zh: 不只是計算不同層神經元之間的權重。

cues.en: We have to actually train this thing somehow and actually run it when we're done.
cues.zh: 還必須用某種方式訓練，完成後實際執行。

cues.en: So the first thing we need to do is load up the training data that contains the features that we want to train on and the target labels to train a neural network.
cues.zh: 因此，首先載入包含待訓練特徵與目標標籤的訓練資料，訓練神經網路。

cues.en: You need to have a set of known inputs with a set of known correct answers that you can use to actually dissenter converge upon the correct solution of weights that lead to the behavior that you want.
cues.zh: 需要一組已知輸入，以及已知正確答案，才能藉此收斂到正確權重解，產生所需行為。

cues.en: After that we need to associate some sort of an optimizer to the network tensorflow makes that very easy to do.
cues.zh: 接著，替網路指定某種最佳化器，TensorFlow 讓這件事很容易。

cues.en: It can be gradient descent or some variation thereof such as Atolm.
cues.zh: 可以是梯度下降，或 Adam 等變形。

cues.en: We will then run our optimizer using our training data and again tensorflow makes that pretty easy to do as well.
cues.zh: 再用訓練資料執行最佳化器，TensorFlow 同樣讓它很容易。

cues.en: Finally, we'll evaluate the results of our training network using our test data set. To recap at a high level.
cues.zh: 最後，用測試資料集，評估訓練好的網路。從整體回顧一下。

cues.en: We're going to create a given network topology and fit the training data using gradient descent to actually converge on the optimal weights between each neuron in our network.
cues.zh: 建立指定的網路拓樸，以梯度下降擬合訓練資料，收斂到網路每個神經元之間的最佳權重。

cues.en: When we're done, we can evaluate the performance of this network using a test dataset that it's never seen before and see if it can correctly classify that data that it was not trained on.
cues.zh: 完成後，用從沒看過的測試資料集，評估效能，看能否正確分類未曾用來訓練的資料。

cues.en: one other gotcha, when you're using neural networks it's very important to make sure that your input data is normalized.
cues.zh: 還有一個注意事項：使用神經網路時，必須確保輸入資料已正規化。

cues.en: Meaning that's all scaled into the same range.
cues.zh: 也就是全部縮放到相同範圍。

cues.en: Generally speaking you want to make sure that your input data has a mean value of zero and unit variance.
cues.zh: 一般而言，希望輸入資料平均值是零、變異數是一。

cues.en: That's just the best way to make the various activation functions work out mathematically.
cues.zh: 這是讓各種激活函數在數學上，最有效運作的方法。

cues.en: What's really important is that your input features are comparable in terms of magnitude.
cues.zh: 真正重要的是，輸入特徵的數量級，彼此可比較。

cues.en: Otherwise it's hard to combine those weights together in a meaningful way.
cues.zh: 否則，很難以有意義的方式組合權重。

cues.en: Your inputs are all the same level at the bottom of your neural network and fitting into that bottom layer.
cues.zh: 輸入都位於神經網路底部同一層，進入底層。

cues.en: It's important that there are comparable in terms of magnitude. So you don't end up skewing things in weighting things in weird ways.
cues.zh: 必須讓數量級可比較，避免扭曲結果，產生奇怪的加權。

cues.en: For example if I already created a neural network that tries to classify people based on their age and their income, age might range from zero to one hundred but income might range from zero to a million.
cues.zh: 例如，建立根據年齡與收入分類人的神經網路，年齡可能從零到一百，收入卻從零到一百萬。

cues.en: Those are wildly different ranges.
cues.zh: 範圍差異極大。

cues.en: So those are going to lead to real mathematical problems if they're not scaled down to the correct range at first.
cues.zh: 如果一開始沒縮放到正確範圍，就會造成真正的數學問題。

cues.en: Fortunately Python psychic learn library has a standard scalar package that you can use that will automatically do that with just one line of code.
cues.zh: 幸好，Python 的 scikit-learn 函式庫，有 StandardScaler，只要一行程式碼，就能自動完成。

cues.en: All you have to do is remember to use it and many datasets that we use while researching will be normalized to begin with. The one we're about to use is already normalized so we don't actually have to do that
cues.zh: 只要記得使用即可，研究用的很多資料集，本來就已正規化。即將使用的資料集已正規化，因此實際上不必做，

cues.en: but later on in the course I'll show you an example of actually using standard scalar. We've talked about how this all works at a low level and in tensorflow too.
cues.zh: 但課程稍後會展示使用 StandardScaler 的範例。我們已談過低階運作方式，在 TensorFlow 2 中，

cues.en: It's still possible to implement a complete neural network basically from scratch. But in tensorflow too they have replaced much of that low-level functionality with a higher-level API called Caris.
cues.zh: 仍能基本上從零，實作完整神經網路。不過 TensorFlow 2 已用更高階的 Keras API，取代許多低階功能。

cues.en: There is value in understanding how it all works under the hood first.
cues.zh: 先理解內部運作，仍有價值。

cues.en: So let's work through a simple example of a neural network using the lower level APIs next.
cues.zh: 因此，接著用較低階 API，做一個簡單神經網路範例。

cues.en: After that we'll see how the carris API simplifies common neural network setups and hides a lot of this complexity from you.
cues.zh: 之後，會看到 Keras API 如何簡化常見的神經網路設定，隱藏大量複雜性。
